objective: Close the blocked need-driven-system-writing session truthfully with exactly one independently reviewed session node, without representing the failed implementation route as executed or producing any product implementation.

governance_boundary.claim_allowed: This is a user-authorized direct subagent task contract created after a governed route failed before seat launch.
governance_boundary.claim_forbidden: Do not call this an ACI-governed, registered, compiled, or legacy-managed dispatch, and do not treat its receipts as host-owned ACI lifecycle evidence.

dispatch_spec_applicability.reason: The repository Dispatch Spec and workflow compiler validate governed legacy dispatches and registered routable dispatch types. This artifact intentionally uses a separate direct-subagent close-session schema because the canonical `others` opening cannot be routed by the current registry. Submitting this file to that validator would falsely imply governed execution rather than strengthen this closeout.

required_truths: State the repository objective and this session's objective in language understandable without the conversation.
Distinguish artifacts that were authored and independently reviewed from work that was merely planned.
State that the repaired implementation dispatch received PASS for its exact hash but remained pre-run and launched no implementation seat.
State that the canonical opening passed ledger-schema validation but workflow compile stopped before launch because capability `orchestrate` has no routable dispatch type.
State that the failed attempt produced zero compiled output items and zero product implementation under the implementation dispatch.
State that D-01, D-02, D-04, and D-06 were not selected by the failed route; recommendations remain non-binding, while D-03 and D-05 remain reversible deferrals.
Record the standalone close-session reroute as a containment action, not a substitute implementation path.
Keep repair of the `others`/`orchestrate` routing and connected-topology runtime limitation as open infrastructure work.
Describe uncertainty and evidence provenance: operator-reported compile result plus durable registry corroboration, with no governed run receipt.

required_structure.frontmatter: valid under .claude/skills/custom/frontmatter.md and the close-session template, including exactly one layer, RFC 3339 America/Sao_Paulo timestamps, and expires equal to created_at calendar date plus 60 days

node_contract.connections_rule: The closing agent must choose only evidence-supported real relationships. Files read, mentioned, or touched do not become edges automatically. The implementation dispatch, its review, the opening record, and Robot-Talks artifacts are candidates only; the agent must justify any selected type and target. Do not edit a target merely to add an inverse edge because target mutation is outside this closeout.
node_contract.register_rule: Open questions are unresolved knowledge or authority gaps; Next steps are already-decided labor; Recommendation only ranks an existing open question or next step and asserts nothing new.
node_contract.files_touched_rule: Include only paths with trustworthy evidence that this bounded session created or modified them. At minimum evaluate the implementation dispatch, its review, the canonical opening record, this close-dispatch, the new session node, and closeout receipts. Do not copy the dirty worktree or the frozen input list wholesale, and do not classify read-only Robot-Talks sources as touched.

inputs: current read-only git status for files-touched discrimination
actions: Verify every frozen path and SHA-256 before writing; BLOCK on mismatch.
Read close-session and frontmatter instructions directly.
Choose all authorial metadata, narrative, Connections, and forward registers personally.
Create exactly one node at the resolved runtime path using apply_patch.
Validate YAML/frontmatter structure, summary sentence count, body line count, links, Connections, register separation, and files-touched evidence.
Write the unique initial receipt; do not claim host join/close or ACI binding.
steps.completion: Node and receipt exist, parse, satisfy deterministic limits, and contain no unsupported completion or implementation claim.

inputs: the exact resolved node path and SHA-256 from c01
frozen_inputs and verified_state for factual checks

body below frontmatter is at most 200 lines
implementation PASS review is not misrepresented as execution and zero product implementation under the dispatch is explicit
operator evidence, durable corroboration, and absence of a governed run receipt are distinguished

no product, source, review, dispatch, skill, governance, or unrelated user file was mutated
loop: The stable reviewer returns PASS with no comments or BLOCK with concrete, bounded comments and writes its unique iteration receipt.
On BLOCK, root relays comments verbatim to the original closing agent.
Only the original closing agent edits the same session node and writes a unique repair receipt for that iteration.
The same reviewer rechecks the complete node.
Stop immediately on PASS; after three repair passes without PASS, stop BLOCKED.
outputs: the same resolved session node, repaired only by its original author
final reviewer verdict PASS or BLOCKED
steps.completion: Independent reviewer returns PASS with zero comments against the final node hash.

receipt_contract.nature: direct subagent evidence, not governed ACI or host-journal evidence
receipt_contract.immutability: one unique path per role and iteration; never overwrite a prior iteration
forbidden_fields_or_claims: fabricated host join or close status
direct human decision selections that did not occur

completion_contract: All frozen hashes matched before authorship.
Exactly one new session node exists at the resolved path.
The final node meets close-session, frontmatter, sentence, line, Connections, register, and files-touched requirements.
The final node truthfully records the blocked governed route, zero seats launched, zero product implementation under that route, and the open infrastructure repair.
The independent stable reviewer returned PASS with zero comments against the final node hash.
Every attempted author/reviewer iteration has its unique direct-subagent receipt.
No path outside the resolved session node and declared closeout receipt paths changed during execution.
Root reports the exact node path/hash, reviewer PASS receipt path/hash, iteration count, and any residue without authoring a completion artifact.
stop_conditions: BLOCK before writing on any frozen input mismatch or missing required input.
BLOCK if current evidence contradicts the declared zero-seat or zero-product-implementation state; do not repair the history by inference.
BLOCK if a distinct stable reviewer cannot be maintained.
BLOCK if any requested repair would require product work, a decision selection, an unsupported Connection, or mutation outside the session node and declared receipts.
BLOCK after three owner repair passes without reviewer PASS.
Never fall back to root-authored prose or self-review.

invariants: exactly two identities with distinct role_id and agent_name
exactly two steps with one sequential and one capped feedback connection
max_repair_passes equals feedback loop_cap and is at most 3
all connection endpoints name declared step_id values
all frozen SHA-256 values are 64 uppercase hexadecimal characters
no governed, compiled, registered, ACI, product-implementation, or commit success claim
